qas.question: who is jethalal
qas.answer: Dilip Joshi is an Indian actor who works in Hindi films and television and is best known for portraying the lead role in the long-running Indian Hindi-language television sitcom , Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah , in which he plays the role of a businessman Jethalal Champaklal Gada , who gets himself in many problems and troubles. The show originally broadcasts on the channel Sony SAB .
